steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Congratulations, you've made it through the first round! Keep it up!
Brushing the sweat from your forehead, you steal a glance back at the relentless white ghost still chasing you.
The ghost draws near while Dudu the Witch leisurely counts the candy pieces in the basket.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: I told you, call me Great Witch!

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Sigh, you're still far from done. Keep going!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait a minute, did you just say... "first round"?
